labeller_notes: Three runs of the same drill (shoot balls in order, one ball per shot into any pocket, cue ball never in hand after the first shot), 14 shots each: run 1 t=8.75..120.6, run 2 t=124.5..244.3, run 3 t=247.9..359.8. 42 shots, 42 balls potted, no scratch, no foul. Racks: runs 1 and 3 have 14 balls (1-14; 15 is not on the table): left column from top 2,4,6,8,10,12,14, right column from top 13,11,9,7,5,3,1. Shot order is 1,2,3,...,14, i.e. alternating right column (from its bottom end) and left column (from its top end). Run 2 is different: two complete sets of solids 1-7 (left column in standard colours: 7 maroon, 6 green, 5 orange, 4 purple, 3 red, 2 blue, 1 yellow from the top; right column in the pink-set colours: 1 yellow, 2 blue, 3 red, 4 pink, 5 purple, 6 green, 7 orange from the top), so numbers repeat and 'potted' alone cannot say which ball; the notes name the column. The order in run 2 is right-column ball n then left-column ball n for n=1..7. Colour mapping: the pink-set colours (4 pink, 5 purple, 7 orange, with 12 pink stripe, 13 purple stripe, 15 orange stripe) match drill08's balls; the brief's list (4 purple, 5 orange, 7 maroon) matches only the left column of run 2. Stripes 9-14 show mostly dark/black rims from above. First contact: in every shot only the target ball moved after the cue ball reached it and the cue ball was seen adjacent to the target at 5 fps (0.2 s) spacing, not frame by frame; no shot's first contact is unsure in my judgement, but the exact contact frame is not stated and pocket names are approximate. t_start = first frame the cue ball moves (cue-ball colour-blob tracker on 640x360 frames, checked by eye on 5 fps contact sheets, about +/-0.1 s). t_end = first time the cue ball has moved less than ~1 px (of 1280) over 0.5 s after the pot; slow creeping can continue a little longer. potted_at is an extra field: approx time the ball is first seen in or at the pocket (+/-0.2 s). Shot 11 of run 1 (t=89.85) was missed by my first automatic onset pass and found by eye. Everything was labelled in one pass from the contact sheets; no frame-by-frame check beyond them.
